q: What is cu-uplift-v2 in the collections-uplift project, and what did it replace?
a: cu-uplift-v2 is a T-learner uplift model with isotonic calibration, used for call routing from December 2025. It replaced cu-uplift-v1 and reached uplift@20% 0.034 on holdout-2025q4 (n=31,200).

q: What came of exp-104, the S-learner uplift test in collections-uplift?
a: The S-learner reached uplift@20% 0.009 on the pilot holdout, below the T-learner's 0.031, so it was dropped and cu-uplift-v1 kept the two-model structure.

q: What features does cu-uplift-v3 in the collections-uplift project depend on?
a: cu-uplift-v3 uses feat-cu-dpd-roll-v1, feat-cu-pay-behaviour, feat-cu-contact-hist-v2 and feat-cu-bureau-delta. feat-cu-call-tod-v1 is excluded after the leakage finding.

q: What is the current call-routing model in the collections-uplift project?
a: cu-uplift-v3, promoted to call routing on 2026-03-25, replacing cu-uplift-v2.

q: What is the uplift@20% of cu-uplift-v3 on the collections-uplift-oot-2026h1 eval set, and what did cu-uplift-v2 get on that set?
a: cu-uplift-v3 reaches uplift@20% 0.038 (CI 0.024-0.052) on collections-uplift-oot-2026h1 (n=28,450). cu-uplift-v2 reaches 0.033 on the same set.

q: Why was feat-cu-call-tod-v1 removed from the collections-uplift models?
a: Its AUC gain (0.68 to 0.75) came mostly from post-contact calls. With only calls up to the contact date, AUC fell to 0.69, so dec-cu-drop-tod excluded the feature.
